title: Evaluation of confirmatory data following the Article 12 MRL review for cycloxydim and modification of the existing MRLs for escaroles, land cresses and cresses
text:
published: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 15:25:44 +0100 Evaluation of confirmatory data following the Article 12 MRL review for cycloxydim and modification of the existing MRLs for escaroles, land cresses and cresses

The applicant BASF SE submitted a request to the competent national authority in the Netherlands to evaluate the confirmatory data for cycloxydim, which had been identified as unavailable in the framework of the maximum residue level (MRL) review under Article 12 of Regulation (EC) No 396/2005. To address the data gaps identified for spring onions, lamb's lettuces, escaroles, cresses and land cresses, additional residue trials on spring onions and open‐leaf lettuce varieties were submitted sufficiently addressing the Article 12 data gaps.
